Bead ddx-2d664f0e asks server construction/shutdown/tests to reference the
public bead.NewLifecycleSubscriber factory and bead.LifecycleSubscriber
interface instead of the concrete public type bead.WatcherHub /
bead.NewWatcherHub, matching TD-027 §21's relocation of the watcher hub
implementation behind internal/lifecycle.

Inspection of the worktree shows this migration is already complete:

- cli/internal/server/server.go:96-102 defines beadHubCloser as
  `bead.LifecycleSubscriber` + `Close()`, and server.go:210-212 constructs it
  via `bead.NewLifecycleSubscriber(...)`. There is no reference to
  `bead.WatcherHub` or `bead.NewWatcherHub` anywhere in cli/internal/server.
- cli/internal/server/server_shutdown_test.go:188-198 defines `spyBeadHub`
  as a struct embedding the `beadHubCloser` interface (built from
  `bead.NewLifecycleSubscriber`), not the concrete `*bead.WatcherHub` type.
- cli/internal/bead/factory.go exposes `NewLifecycleSubscriber` as the public
  entrypoint; the concrete `WatcherHub` type now lives only in
  cli/internal/bead/internal/lifecycle/watcher_hub.go (internal package), so
  it cannot be embedded or constructed from the public bead package.
- `grep -rn "WatcherHub" --include='*.go' cli | grep -v _test.go` returns
  only internal/bead/internal/lifecycle/watcher_hub.go and
  internal/bead/factory.go — no hits in cli/internal/server.

Running the AC4 verification command confirms all targeted packages pass,
including TestServerShutdownCallsWorkerManagerShutdown and
TestGraphQLBeadLifecycleSubscription (internal/server) and
TestIntegration_Subscription_BeadLifecycle (internal/server/graphql):
